newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Railtrack posts 12 percent profit gain.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Railtrack posts 12 percent profit gain.

text.p: Railtrack Plc, the British railway owner which was privatised in May, said Friday its operating profits rose 12 percent in the first six months of its fiscal year.

Headline pretax profits for the six months ended Sept. 30 jumped to 173 million pounds ($288 million) from 98 million pounds ($163 million), boosted by a drop in interest charges because the government cut its debt before privatisation.
The company said operating profits rose to 169 million pounds ($282 million) from 151 million ($252 million).
